name: DMA Industries LLC
old_description: DMA Industries delivers industry-leading private label programs that define excellence in quality, speed-to-market, and value. Supported by deep expertise in engineering, branding, packaging, logistics, and distribution, we provide fully integrated, end-to-end solutions that power some of the nation’s most successful private label platforms.
about:
DMA Industries LLC is based in Tabor City, North Carolina, where it has established itself as a provider of private label programs for the automotive aftermarket.

The company delivers industry-leading private label programs that define excellence in quality, speed-to-market, and value, supported by deep expertise in engineering, branding, packaging, logistics, and distribution. Its product lineup includes precision-engineered strut assemblies, installation kits with gaskets, fuel clips, and hardware, all meeting Grade 10.9 and SAE Grade 8 specifications. A strategic partnership with Zhejiang Sensen Auto Parts under the SDI joint venture added a manufacturing and distribution complex in Thailand, allowing DMA to avoid tariffs on Chinese-origin products while maintaining North American OE standards.

DMA serves automotive aftermarket distributors, retailers, and private label brands across North America. Its catalog spans makes from Acura to Volvo, and the company emphasizes direct customer service, promising that every call is answered by a knowledgeable person rather than an automated attendant.

The company says its integrated, end-to-end solutions and tariff-mitigation strategy set it apart, enabling faster speed-to-market and reliable supply for private label platforms.
